sum: Yunji Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a membership-based social e-commerce platform under the Yunji App name in the People's Republic of China. The company offers various categories, including beauty and personal care, healthcare products, household goods, apparel, shoes and bags, beverages, food and fresh produce, electronics and home appliances, childcare products, and baby and maternity products. Yunji Inc. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, the People's Republic of China.
